subject: POC scope & RACI: Nimbus Retail trial — timeline and owners
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbusretail.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: James O'Rourke <james.orourke@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps: evaluation scope & timeline

Hi Laura / Rishi,

Thanks again for the call this morning — it was helpful to see how Redwood routes and scales inference. Quick recap and asks so we can lock the trial dates: 

1) Success criteria (draft) — please confirm if these map to what you heard: 
   - <KPI 1> 95th percentile latency under 300ms for typical retail queries
   - <KPI 2> embedding recall > 0.82 on the sample SKU set
   - <KPI 3> stable throughput at 120 qps for 30 minute sustained window

2) Scope: 2-week sandbox POC with our staging catalog (~50k SKUs). We need a dedicated sandbox endpoint and read-only access to metrics.

3) Ownership questions we uncovered on the call — please confirm owners and any prerequisites: 
   - infra/networking (VPN/VPC peering): who at Redwood will own setup?
   - app integration (API hooks, transform logic): who owns integration support?
   - security review (SAQ, SOC2 artifacts): who will manage questionnaire and evidence?
   - procurement (PO, SOW, payment): timeline expectations from your side?

4) Timing: we'd ideally start the sandbox week of Sep 13; procurement would like the SOW and an estimated cost by Sep 6 to route a PO.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (draft), Nimbus-SOC2-questions.pdf

Next steps from our side: Alicia to confirm internal stakeholders and available sandbox credentials window. From Redwood: please confirm owners and who I should loop for the security packet.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Data Platforms, Nimbus Retail
A: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)]
[Attachment: Nimbus-SOC2-questions.pdf (pdf, 210KB)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC next steps: evaluation scope & timeline

Alicia — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming from our side and assigning owners so we have single points of contact during the trial. Please see RACI-lite below (R=responder/owner, A=accountable, C=consulted, I=informed):

- Infra / VPC peering / sandbox endpoint: R: rishi_malhotra (Redwood Infra), A: laura_bennett, C: Nimbus infra (James), I: marissa_cole
- App integration / API wiring + test harness: R: marissa_cole (Solutions Eng), A: laura_bennett, C: Alicia, I: rishi_malhotra
- Security / SAQ & evidence: R: neha_kapoor (Security), A: neha_kapoor, C: laura_bennett, I: Alicia
- Procurement / SOW & PO tracking: R: monica_patel (Finance Ops), A: monica_patel, C: laura_bennett, I: Alicia

Quick answers to your asks:
- Sandbox: we can provision a dedicated sandbox for the week of Sep 13. Rishi will send a VPC peering checklist and invite for a short network call.
- Success criteria: attached spreadsheet looks good — Marissa, can you confirm whether the embedding recall target is achievable with our default quantized configs or if we should suggest a model variant?
- SOW / costs: Monica will circulate a draft SOW and ballpark estimate by Sep 3 to give your procurement time.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Sep 3: Redwood sends SOW + estimate (Monica)
- Sep 6: Nimbus confirms PO timeline / signoff ability
- Sep 10-12: network pairing & sandbox readiness
- Sep 13: POC go-live (2 weeks)

Next steps: Monica will attach the SOW draft; Rishi will follow up on networking availability; Marissa will review the success criteria spreadsheet and comment.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.com

Laura — appreciate the speed. A couple of adjustments from procurement: 
- PO cutoff is Sep 20 for this quarter spend; we can start the POC earlier if the SOW is signed/PO issued, otherwise we need to start Sep 13 only as contingency.
- For security, our InfoSec wants a short 30-minute walkthrough of the evidence (SOC2 artifacts + network topology) before we turn on the sandbox. Neha — would Thursday Sep 9 at 10am PT work?

James (cc) will handle internal scheduling for the PO routing. Also, can you include an estimated token cost range for the 2-week run at the proposed throughput? That helps procurement size the PO.

Thanks,
Alicia
